body:
@Shipow Prefetching is a good idea but should be still configurable in my opinion. Starting at 1 character as a default is good enough but as a user, especially a mobile one, doesn't want an additional HTTP request fired with *no* inserted terms.

@vvo My use case is to replicate a documentation search box like [Laravel's](http://http://laravel.com/docs/5.1). As you can see no request are fired until at least one character is typed.
